items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Ragtime or Shawty Schuss or Alderman? Just like you know the fellas playing hillbillies like the hillbilly bands play?

ctx.x: What kind of music did they play? What did they sound like?

Ragtime or Shawty Schuss or Alderman? Just like you know the fellas playing hillbillies like the hillbilly bands play? Yeah, that's the kind of music they played. It had a good beat to it. Oh yeah, it had a good beat. You could dance by it. Of course it wouldn't, it didn't have the pep, the jazz, and the, like a good heavy band like reed and brass together you see. But they played, a whole lot of them was good too, the string bands. People used to like them.

Well there was one more trumpet player I had on my list to ask about, it's Edwards. Edwards, Edwards, remember wasn't there one Ralph? Willie Edwards? Is it Willie Edwards or something? Willie Edwards. It was a dead-barred clam, I don't think we got it mixed up. I think Punch talked about Willie Edwards. Yeah, Willie Edwards and stuff. Do you remember?
